newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says 4.9 pct of shares in for redemption.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says 4.9 pct of shares in for redemption.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Thursday that the number of shares submitted for redemption amounts to 4.9 percent of total shares and 3.1 percent of the total number of votes.
This represented a 97.5 percent acceptance of Volvo's offer which, as previously announced, calculated the redemption amount per share at 257 crowns.

Volvo said in a statement that a special general meeting will be held on June 26 to decide on the board's proposal to reduce share capital by 113 million crowns and repay shareholders a total redemption amount of 5.81 billion crowns.

"In addition the special general meeting will address the board's proposal for a bonus issue through a write-up of the par value of the Volvo share from five to six crowns and related change in the Articles of Association," Volvo said.
Payment of the redemption amount is expected to be made on July 10.
Volvo announced in March that it would redeem one in every 20 shares, or a maximum of five percent of the total number, at 40 crowns above the market price.
If the redemption programme was fully realised, the number of Volvo shares would decline to 441 million from 463.6 million.
